collection.description: An elder announces that today is a lucky day: try something bold, or carry on as normal.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: At breakfast, (subject), an elder, announces with complete confidence that today is a lucky day. (subject.He/She) can feel it in (subject.his/her) knees. A few of the younger villagers laugh. A few others start wondering what they should try, if today is really lucky.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (friend) decides to try, at last, to climb the tall palm (friend.he/she) has never managed. (friend.He/She) gets further up than ever before, though not to the top. (cook), another villager, tries a new recipe, which is mostly good. A third, (third), finally asks (pal), a friend, to go fishing, and (pal) says yes. Was it a lucky day? Everyone has their own opinion. Most of them had a very good day, at least.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: Most people carry on as normal. It's a normal sort of day: some good things happen, some bad things happen. At dinner, (subject) asks if everyone had a lucky day. One person says yes. One person says no. Most say "about average." (subject) nods wisely. "Lucky days come in all sizes," (subject.he/she) says. Nobody is sure what that means.
